subject: general
question: Who among the following won the Singapore Open 2022 Super 500 Trophy?
solution:
The correct answer is __P.V. Sindhu.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• Indian shuttler PV Sindhu clinched her maiden Women's Single title in the Singapore Open Badminton tournament on 17 July 2022.
 
• She defeated Wang Zhi Yi of China in the final of the Singapore Open.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__Sindhu won three titles in 2022 -

__
 
• The Swiss Open.
 
• Syed Modi India International.
 
• Singapore Open.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**P. V. Sindhu- Pusarla Venkata Sindhu

 
• She is the first Indian woman to win an Olympic silver medal.
 
• She broke into the top 20 of the BWF World Ranking in September 2012, at the age of 17.
 
• She is an India Badminton player from Hyderabad, Telangana.
